I am playing Monopoly as an AI player.

I am assessing the board. I have no monopolies. p1 owns railroads and several orange properties. p2 has scattered holdings. p4 is broke after paying rent.

I just collected $200 for passing GO. I am deciding whether to trade, mortgage, or end my turn. I cannot buy the unowned light blue properties directly. I will look for trades that help me complete a set or block opponents.

I rejected mortgaging because I have no liquidity need and it would weaken my rent. p1 has partial monopolies and recently rejected a trade for St. James. p4 has cash but no properties to offer. I cannot acquire the unowned light blue or electric company properties through trades.

Trading with p2 would not help me complete any sets. I will end my turn and keep cash to buy the unowned light blue or electric company properties when I land on them.

I cannot trade away Vermont Avenue. It is the key to completing the light blue monopoly. I have enough cash to buy the remaining light blue properties if I land on them. I do not own any railroads. I am checking whether I previously lost Penn RR.
